comment: EMIT-ONLY. `tsconfig.json` stays the typecheck project (noEmit, tests + scripts included) and its semantics MUST NOT move; this one narrows the program to `src/**` and turns emit on. `types` drops `vitest/globals`: the published build MUST NOT compile against a test global. `resolveJsonModule` is inherited and inert — nothing under `src/` imports a .json (the profiles and golden sets are read at RUNTIME by path, which is why they ship as `files`, not as emitted modules).
